description: This file implements the Rational class, including constructors, arithmetic operators, comparison operators, and conversion methods, for handling rational numbers within the CalcEngine namespace.

classes.name: Rational
classes.description: A class representing rational numbers with methods for arithmetic operations, comparisons, and conversions.

methods.name: Rational()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing a Rational object.

methods.name: Rational(Number const& n)
methods.description: Constructs a Rational from a Number, adjusting the exponent if negative.

methods.name: Rational(Number const& p, Number const& q)
methods.description: Constructs a Rational from numerator and denominator Numbers.

methods.name: Rational(int32_t i)
methods.description: Constructs a Rational from a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: Rational(uint32_t ui)
methods.description: Constructs a Rational from a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: Rational(uint64_t ui)
methods.description: Constructs a Rational from a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: Rational(PRAT prat)
methods.description: Constructs a Rational from a PRAT pointer.

methods.name: ToPRAT()
methods.description: Converts the Rational to a PRAT structure.

methods.name: P()
methods.description: Returns the numerator part of the Rational.

methods.name: Q()
methods.description: Returns the denominator part of the Rational.

methods.name: operator-()
methods.description: Negates the Rational number.

methods.name: operator+=(Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Adds another Rational to this Rational.

methods.name: operator-=(Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Subtracts another Rational from this Rational.

methods.name: operator*=(Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Multiplies this Rational by another Rational.

methods.name: operator/=(Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Divides this Rational by another Rational.

methods.name: operator%=(Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Calculates the remainder after division by another Rational.

methods.name: operator<<=(Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Left-shifts the Rational by another Rational.

methods.name: operator>>=(Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Right-shifts the Rational by another Rational.

methods.name: operator&=(Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND with another Rational.

methods.name: operator|=(Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Performs bitwise OR with another Rational.

methods.name: operator^=(Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Performs bitwise XOR with another Rational.

methods.name: operator+(Rational lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Adds two Rationals.

methods.name: operator-(Rational lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Subtracts two Rationals.

methods.name: operator*(Rational lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Multiplies two Rationals.

methods.name: operator/(Rational lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Divides two Rationals.

methods.name: operator%(Rational lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Calculates the modulus of two Rationals.

methods.name: operator<<(Rational lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Left-shifts two Rationals.

methods.name: operator>>(Rational lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Right-shifts two Rationals.

methods.name: operator&(Rational lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Bitwise AND of two Rationals.

methods.name: operator|(Rational lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Bitwise OR of two Rationals.

methods.name: operator^(Rational lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Bitwise XOR of two Rationals.

methods.name: operator==(Rational const& lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Checks equality of two Rationals.

methods.name: operator!=(Rational const& lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Checks inequality of two Rationals.

methods.name: operator<(Rational const& lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Checks if one Rational is less than another.

methods.name: operator>(Rational const& lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Checks if one Rational is greater than another.

methods.name: operator<=(Rational const& lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Checks if one Rational is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: operator>=(Rational const& lhs, Rational const& rhs)
methods.description: Checks if one Rational is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: ToString(uint32_t radix, NumberFormat fmt, int32_t precision)
methods.description: Converts the Rational to a string representation.

methods.name: ToUInt64_t()
methods.description: Converts the Rational to a 64-bit unsigned integer.
